info.title: API.SH: DHgate
info.description: The DHgate API from API.SH: public DHgate data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One DHgate product: title, url, category, `price` (min and max in US dollars, original prices, discount, promotion end, and the quantity `tiers` with their unit prices), unit, minimum and maximum order, lot size, sold count, package size and weight, full-size `images`, `variants` (colors, sizes, models with their images), stock, `specifications`, `highlights`, the seller's `description` (text and HTML), `shipping` to the US (method, cost, free, delivery days, estimated delivery, handling days), rating, review count and breakdown, review tags, and the `store` (id, name, url, supplier id, positive feedback, transactions, level, country, years, followers, product count, company details). `latest=true` with search params opens the first product of that search. Removed products answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dhgate-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product item code (`id` in search, e.g. `404047032`) or its dhgate.com/product/... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first (non-sponsored) product of a search with the same params (`q`, filters).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: the search keywords.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Buyer reviews of a DHgate product: `id`, `rating`, `text`, `date`, buyer nickname and level, country, helpful count, the variant bought, review `images` and video, the seller's reply and `raw`. Filters: with photos, buyer country and review tag; sort by newest or most helpful. Page 1 also returns the `summary` (average, count, photo count, transactions, store review count, star breakdown, tags). 10 reviews a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dhgate-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product item code (e.g. `404047032`) or its link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: with_photos
parameters.description: `true`: only reviews with photos or video.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Only reviews from buyers in this country (two letters, e.g. `US`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only reviews with this tag (a name from `summary.tags`, e.g. `Satisfied`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on DHgate (dhgate.com, wholesale marketplace) for keywords or a category, with every filter and sort of the search page: category, price range, free shipping, on sale, top rated, VIP price, Buyers' Picks, free samples, customizable, 7-day return, single piece, US warehouse, maximum minimum order, brand and ship-to country. Each product: `id` (item code), `title`, `url`, `image`, price text and `price_min`/`price_max` in US dollars, original price, unit, minimum order, discount and promotion end, free shipping, 7-day return and US-warehouse flags, rating, review count, sold count text, positive feedback, `sponsored`, category id, the `store` (id, name, url, supplier id, level) and `raw`. `facets` lists categories (with sub-categories and counts), brands and attributes; `related_searches` the site's related keywords. 40 products a page (sponsored products come on top), up to the first 3,000 matches; `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dhgate-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `phone case`, `wedding dress`. Optional with `category`.

get.description:
A DHgate store (seller): name, logo, headline and description, supplier id, positive feedback, transactions, DHgate's service scores (on-time delivery, repurchase rate), location, open since, seller level, popular searches and the `reviews` summary of all its products (total, with photos, from the ship-to country, star breakdown, tags). Products are on /dhgate/v1/store-products and reviews on /dhgate/v1/store-reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dhgate-store

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The store number (`store.id` in search and product, e.g. `20750510`) or its dhgate.com/store/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The keyword suggestions DHgate's search box shows for the text typed so far (up to 10).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dhgate-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text typed so far, e.g. `iphone`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
